result.title: Privacy-preserving inference on hosted models: a learned input-embedding transform for frozen Qwen3.8-27B
result.summary: Every prompt sent to a hosted language model is readable by whoever runs it. We study whether the prompt can remain on the client while the host receives transformed vectors that stand in for it. A language model converts text to vectors exactly once, with a public lookup table; we perform that step locally and pass the vectors through a small trained network (55.6M parameters) before they leave the perimeter. The host runs a frozen 27B model (Qwen3.8-27B) on the transformed vectors and never receives text or token ids. We train the transform against the frozen model as a fixed judge, combining a forward-KL utility term with an auxiliary term that pushes each vector away from its original direction. On 1,490 MMLU questions held out from training, the transform costs 1.5 points of accuracy (80.7% vs. 82.3%), breaking 68 of the 1,226 questions the unmodified model answers correctly (5.5%), while 30.1% of content tokens no longer decode to their original token under a nearest-neighbour lookup.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究托管模型的隐私推理：客户端本地完成 token 到向量的查表，再用 55.6M 参数的小网络变换输入嵌入后交给冻结的 Qwen3.8-27B，以 forward-KL 效用项叠加「偏离原方向」的正则项训练，并在 1,490 道 held-out MMLU 题上测量精度损失与最近邻可解码比例。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「变换嵌入＋冻结下游模型＋最近邻解码」的评测方式，可供核查下游能取用多少原始信息，可能迁移到 LVR 中 latent 视觉内容保留与信息坍缩的度量，但属纯文本且与视觉推理无直接关联。
